description.value: River's Reach Pub is a multi-award-winning neighbourhood pub in New Westminster that has been operating since December 2000, collecting six Newsleader A-List and thirteen Record Reader's Choice Best Pub awards. The interior recreates an early 1900s West Coast atmosphere with river rock, old-growth hardwoods, fireplaces, and 19th-century antiques. Cyclists stopping in will find a full kitchen menu, an extensive beer list with domestic, import, and craft options, wines, and cocktails — with a 19+ age restriction throughout.
